user.title: Set up Changan UNI-V
user.description: Create the read-only vehicle entities. Then choose Reconfigure → Account authentication to complete SMS login. Remote vehicle control remains disabled.

reconfigure_account.title: Authenticate Gravity Domain account
reconfigure_account.description: The phone number is used only by this flow to request verification codes and is not saved after authentication.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate Gravity Domain account
reauth_confirm.description: The account session has expired. The phone number is used only by this flow and is not saved after authentication.

graphics_captcha.description:
Enter the four digits shown below.

sms_code.title: Enter the SMS verification code
sms_code.description: The code is used only for this login and is not written to Home Assistant configuration or logs.
